Intro: Bow before me, lowly chef. For it is I, the only, venerable Eve. The mystic chosen personally by God who will soon save this city.
This will be a fine establishment to make my base of operations.
Be humble, for this store will one day be a holy site remembered in history blessed by my presence.
I am quite hungry, chef, do not disappoint me.
Success: My judgement was not wrong, this will be the new holy site for my followers. I knew God would not fail me.
Fail: Ugh…this will not only no longer be my holy site, it will henceforth be known as an evil restaurant that attempted to scam the savior of this city!
Reject: You dare to reject me? You are even more of a fool than my little brother.
